title: RightBrainAI Raises Multi-Ten-Million RMB Angel Led by Lightspeed China for Visual AIGC
summary: On June 5, 2023, visual-content AI platform RightBrainAI (右脑科技) raised a multi-ten-million RMB angel led by Lightspeed China Partners (光速光合), with MiraclePlus following — second check within months after MiraclePlus seed at founding (Sep 2022). Use: algo R&D, product, team.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / financing · June 8, 2023

On June 5, 2023, visual-content AI platform RightBrainAI (右脑科技) raised a multi-ten-million RMB angel led by Lightspeed China Partners (光速光合), with MiraclePlus following — second check within months after MiraclePlus seed at founding (Sep 2022). Use: algo R&D, product, team.

Three PKU co-founders; MSRA / SenseTime Research / BAAI pedigrees; NeurIPS/ECCV papers. Core contributors to multimodal pretrain NUWA / NUWA Infinity, BAAI Wudao text-to-image and Chinese-painting models, ex-SenseTime video-gen researchers. NUWA (2021) beat then-SOTA (incl. DALL·E) across 8 cross-modal synthesis modes (T2I, T2V, video prediction).

Self-built 10B-param expert models for high-quality styled images (quality, realism, detail, controllability). Parallel video-gen R&D: style-model→video transfer; controllable fast video foundation model; T2V / I2V / video transform — rare domestic full video-gen stack. Thesis vs “AI Four Dragons” commercial plateau: AIGC remakes visual production; simple T2I ≠ pro needs; early image+video explorers convert research to product fastest.

0 CN images. Author Jiacheng · Review Ski.

— END —
